valerius_exp_objective_before_obedience.title: Objective Before Obedience
valerius_exp_objective_before_obedience.interpretation: You treat Valerius's order as a mission with constraints rather than a demand for deference. He notices that you are trying to understand command intent, not merely perform obedience.

valerius_exp_report_without_theatre.title: The Report Without Theatre
valerius_exp_report_without_theatre.interpretation: You report the patrol as it actually happened, including a weakness in the Watch deployment. Valerius gains evidence that your reliability includes unwelcome information rather than only compliant performance.

valerius_exp_order_questioned.title: The Order He Let You Question
valerius_exp_order_questioned.interpretation: You challenge an order by showing how it endangers the mission the order was meant to serve. Valerius changes the deployment without treating disciplined dissent as disloyalty.

valerius_exp_merchant_leak_delegated.title: Command Without a Leash
valerius_exp_merchant_leak_delegated.interpretation: Valerius chooses to give you mission intent and constraints rather than a scripted route because earlier disciplined dissent proved that your independent judgment can remain aligned with the objective.

valerius_exp_merchant_leak_broken.title: The Patrol He Let You Rewrite
valerius_exp_merchant_leak_broken.interpretation: You use Silas's intelligence to rewrite the patrol response within Valerius's stated objective, break the leak's operational value, and return with a result produced by delegated judgment rather than close supervision.

valerius_exp_aftermath_public_crackdown.title: Closure Everyone Can See
valerius_exp_aftermath_public_crackdown.interpretation: You choose a visible purge of the compromised routes. Valerius sees a decision that restores institutional control cleanly, even though others in the room price the collateral cost differently.

valerius_exp_aftermath_protect_source.title: An Open Risk Kept Deliberately
valerius_exp_aftermath_protect_source.interpretation: Valerius understands the intelligence value of preserving Silas's source but sees you deliberately leave an institutional vulnerability alive. The reasoning becomes clearer while trust in the choice falls.

valerius_exp_aftermath_quiet_reroute.title: Control Without the Spectacle
valerius_exp_aftermath_quiet_reroute.interpretation: You preserve the objective while declining the clean public gesture: alter the routes until the leak stops buying advantage. Valerius recognizes the same mission-over-script reasoning that first made delegation possible.

valerius_exp_repair_for_load.title: The Repair That Takes Longer
valerius_exp_repair_for_load.interpretation: The slower repair is politically inconvenient, but Valerius recognizes that you are applying the same objective-over-appearance discipline he previously rewarded. Warmth drops slightly while understanding and trust in judgment increase.

valerius_exp_repair_for_show.title: Visible Order Restored First
valerius_exp_repair_for_show.interpretation: You prioritize reopening the district on a schedule the Watch can defend publicly. Valerius values the restored order even though Gronk sees the same decision as knowingly under-repairing the real load path.

valerius_memory_order_questioned.title: The Order He Let You Question
valerius_memory_order_questioned.summary: You challenged an order by naming the objective it endangered, and Valerius changed the deployment instead of demanding ceremonial obedience.
valerius_memory_order_questioned.protagonistView: Valerius values discipline enough to revise an order when the mission demands it. His authority is more useful when it can survive a precise objection.
valerius_memory_order_questioned.targetView: The player can question command without confusing dissent with defiance. That makes independent judgment something I can delegate rather than suppress.

valerius_memory_merchant_leak_broken.title: The Patrol He Let You Rewrite
valerius_memory_merchant_leak_broken.summary: Valerius gave you intent rather than a script, and the patrol you rewrote broke the merchant-district leak without sacrificing the mission.
valerius_memory_merchant_leak_broken.protagonistView: Valerius trusted me with judgment instead of compliance. The result matters because his authority survived becoming less direct.
valerius_memory_merchant_leak_broken.targetView: The player can carry command intent through incomplete information and return with an outcome I would have accepted even if I had not chosen the route myself.
